# Task P1-03: Version-flag parser

**Phase:** 1 · **Depends on:** none · **Suggested tier:** cheap worker · **Estimated size:** S

## Goal
One parser decides whether a title denotes a *version* of a song — live, remix, acoustic, radio edit, remaster, karaoke, cover… — from the track title, the MusicBrainz recording disambiguation and the release group's secondary types, and returns the bare title with version hints and `feat.` clauses removed. Identity resolution (P1-06) uses it to prefer the studio recording and to compare titles; the decision engine (Phase 2) uses the same flags for its "version mismatch" rejection (`MATCHING_ENGINE.md` §6.2). Behaviour is pinned by golden cases in `tests/fixtures/version-flags.json`.

## Deliverables
1. `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/VersionFlags.cs` — `[Flags] public enum VersionFlags` in this order: `None = 0, Live, Remix, Acoustic, Instrumental, Acapella, RadioEdit, Edit, Extended, Remaster, Explicit, Clean, Cover, Karaoke, Demo, Slowed, EightD, BassBoosted` (powers of two). A static class `VersionFlagNames` with `string ToWireName(VersionFlags single)` / `bool TryParse(string wire, out VersionFlags)` / `IReadOnlyList<string> ToWireNames(VersionFlags flags)` (in enum order) using the wire names `live, remix, acoustic, instrumental, acapella, radio_edit, edit, extended, remaster, explicit, clean, cover, karaoke, demo, slowed, 8d, bassboosted` (these are what `song.version_flags` stores). Also `VersionFlags HardFlags` = every flag except `Remaster`, `Explicit`, `Clean` (the soft ones; §6.2 treats remaster as soft, and explicit/clean only adjust the score).
2. `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/VersionFlagParser.cs` — `public static class VersionFlagParser` with `VersionInfo Parse(string title, string? disambiguation = null, IReadOnlyCollection<string>? releaseGroupSecondaryTypes = null)` and `public sealed record VersionInfo(VersionFlags Flags, string BaseTitle, IReadOnlyList<string> Hints)` (`Hints` = the raw segments that produced flags or were stripped, for debugging/UI).
3. `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests/Metadata/VersionFlagParserTests.cs` — a `[Theory]` over every case in `tests/fixtures/version-flags.json` (load via a `<None Include="..\..\tests\fixtures\version-flags.json" Link="fixtures\version-flags.json" CopyToOutputDirectory="PreserveNewest" />` item in the test csproj), comparing flags as a set and `baseTitle` exactly, plus facts for the wire-name helpers.

## Rules (the fixture is authoritative where these words are ambiguous)
**Segments.** Only *segments* are examined, never the words of the main title ("Live and Let Die", "Remix to Ignition" and "Mix Tape" have no flags):
- every bracketed group `( … )` or `[ … ]` in the title;
- dash suffixes: split on ` - ` (space-hyphen-space, also en/em dash with spaces) from the right; a suffix is a segment **only if** it contains a flag keyword, a neutral keyword or a `feat` clause — otherwise it stays part of the title ("Mr. Blue Sky - Jeff Lynne Version");
- the whole disambiguation string, if any (every word counts there);
- secondary types map directly: `Live` → Live, `Remix` and `DJ-mix` → Remix, `Demo` → Demo; `Compilation`, `Soundtrack` and the rest → nothing.

**Keywords** (case-insensitive, whole words unless noted; a segment can yield several flags; `/`, `+`, `,`, `-` inside a segment separate words):
- Live: `live` (also `live at|on|from …`), `in concert`, `unplugged` (→ Live **and** Acoustic)
- Acoustic: `acoustic`, `unplugged`, `stripped`
- Instrumental: `instrumental`
- Acapella: `a cappella`, `a capella`, `acapella`, `acappella`
- Karaoke: `karaoke`, `backing track`
- Cover: `cover`, `covered by`, `originally performed by`, `in the style of`, `made famous by`, `tribute`
- RadioEdit: `radio edit`, `radio version`, `radio mix`
- Extended: `extended` (including `extended mix`, `extended version`)
- Edit: `edit` not part of `radio edit`; in a disambiguation also `intro`/`outro` (DJ versions with added intros)
- Remix: `remix`, `rmx`, `dub`, and any word **ending in** `mix` (`Hotmix`, `Club Mix`) **except** `radio mix` (RadioEdit), `extended mix` (Extended), `original mix` and `<4-digit year> mix`, `mono mix`, `stereo mix`, `album mix`, `single mix` (neutral)
- Remaster: `remaster`, `remastered`
- Explicit: `explicit`, `dirty`; Clean: `clean`, `censored`
- Demo: `demo`
- Slowed: `slowed`, `sped up`, `speed up`, `nightcore`, `reverb`
- EightD: `8d`; BassBoosted: `bass boosted`, `bassboosted`

**Neutral keywords** (no flag, but the segment is stripped from `BaseTitle`): `original mix`, `original version`, `album version`, `single version`, `mono`, `stereo`, `mono version`, `stereo version`, `bonus track`, and `from "…"`/`from '…'` (soundtrack attributions).

**Feat.** A segment starting with `feat.`, `feat `, `ft.`, `featuring` or `with ` is stripped (no flag); inside a flagged segment the feat part is ignored. A trailing ` feat. X` / ` ft. X` / ` featuring X` on the main title (outside brackets) is stripped too.

**BaseTitle** = the title with every segment that produced a flag, a neutral keyword or a feat clause removed; other bracketed groups stay ("(I Can't Get No) Satisfaction", "Symphony No. 5 (Part 2)"); whitespace trimmed and collapsed; no trailing ` -`.

- `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/VersionFlags.cs`, `src/Compilarr.Core/Metadata/VersionFlagParser.cs`
- `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests/Metadata/VersionFlagParserTests.cs`, `tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests/Compilarr.Core.Tests.csproj` (fixture item only)
- `tests/fixtures/version-flags.json` — you may **add** cases (e.g. for edge cases you find), never change or remove existing ones

## Context to read first
- `docs/architecture/MATCHING_ENGINE.md` §6.1–6.2 (version hints, hard vs soft)
- `tests/fixtures/version-flags.json` (all 75 cases)

## Constraints
- Pure code, no I/O, no new packages. Compile regexes once (`static readonly` / `[GeneratedRegex]`); `RegexOptions.CultureInvariant | IgnoreCase`.
- Keep it table-driven (keyword → flag list) so later phases can add hints without touching the algorithm.

## Acceptance criteria (each must be demonstrated)
1. `dotnet build -warnaserror` → 0 warnings, 0 errors; `dotnet test` → all pass (paste the summary lines, including the number of theory cases run for the fixture: ≥ 75).
2. Every fixture case passes unchanged.
3. `VersionFlagNames.ToWireNames(VersionFlags.Live | VersionFlags.RadioEdit)` → `["live", "radio_edit"]`; `TryParse("8d", …)` → `EightD`; `TryParse("nope", …)` → false; `HardFlags` excludes exactly Remaster, Explicit and Clean.

## Out of scope
- Title similarity scoring, filename parsing (Phase 2), any use of the parser by other components.
